question: 'Ace against Odds' is an autobiography by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sania Mirza.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Sania Mirza**

 
 
• She is a professional **tennis player** from India.
 
• She is a former** world No. 1 in doubles** and has **six Grand Slam titles **to her credit.
 
• From** 2003** until her retirement from singles in** 2013**, she was ranked by the **Women's Tennis Association** as** India's No. 1 player**. 
 
• Sania Mirza has also been conferred with the** Arjuna Award in 2004**, **Padma Shri in 2006**, **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna **(now called the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award) i
